services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Take your special event farther… aboard the most photographed boat in the entire Tampa Bay Region, SUNCOAST HORIZON. With cushioned seating and catering available, your special event will be the most memorable under sail. Suncoast Horizon can comfortably accommodate up to 25 passengers and is perfect for weddings, bachelor & bachelorette parties, birthdays, anniversaries, company parties and outings. Designed by the famous marine architect, Merritt Walter and built in Old Town, Florida, in 2000, Suncoast Horizon is a working replica of the schooners of old with the modern comforts of today. blurb: Guests sail aboard a U.S. Coast Guard–inspected schooner certified for up to 28 passengers, limited to about 21 for comfort. Trips include cruising through historic John’s Pass and into the Gulf. BYOB is allowed and bottled water is provided.
